tools.name: roku-preview
tools.title: Preview Roku Instruction
tools.description: Resolve a supported instruction for one saved TV without sending controls. Returns an immutable preview ID that expires after ten minutes.

tools.name: roku-instruction
tools.title: Run Roku Instruction
tools.description: Confirm and execute a single-use preview ID from Preview Roku Instruction. Rechecks the saved plan before controlling the TV.

ai.instructions: Use roku-status to find saved TVs and routines before controlling anything. Then call roku-preview with the supported instruction and exact saved deviceId. Each preview must target one TV only; use separate previews for different TVs. Show the returned resolved actions and TV, then call roku-instruction with exactly the returned previewId for Raycast confirmation and execution. Never invent, substitute or reuse preview IDs. A preview expires after ten minutes and is consumed before execution, even if execution fails. If it expires or current settings change, create and show a new preview rather than retrying the old ID. All core commands and routines are free and work without AI. Preserve the user's explicit room targeting. Never invent an explicit room to bypass a device that requires explicit naming. Do not guess device IDs, app IDs, current mute state, or current playback state. State-specific mute, unmute, play, and pause are unsupported; only explicit toggles are supported. Use the exact configured routine name when requested. For a command that omits the room, use only the configured default TV when allowed; never pick the first TV. Each clause without a target uses the default independently. Completed commands do not prove physical effects unless the result explicitly confirms state. Do not promise arbitrary movie search, content playback, or subscriptions. Do not change aliases or protection settings. Never retry toggle commands automatically.
